description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
vibe: Glue, don't rewrite — route cleanly, test everything, and never touch upstream code.
highlights: Explicit positioning as installer/doctor/config tool, not a wrapper — agents call upstream tools directly after install
Strict channel contract: every platform file inherits BaseChannel and implements can_handle/read/search/check
Hard rule against modifying upstream open source projects — Agent Reach is a glue layer only
Version must match in three places: pyproject.toml, __init__.py, tests/test_cli.py
Cookie-based auth constrained to Cookie-Editor export only (no QR scan, which hangs for XHS)
assessment: This file demonstrates mature systems thinking by drawing a sharp architectural boundary: Agent Reach routes and diagnoses but never reimplements upstream tools, which keeps the surface area small and the maintenance burden low. The enforced channel contract and three-place version sync show a bias toward mechanical consistency over cleverness, while the explicit auth workarounds encode hard-won operational knowledge. The result is a codebase that stays honest about its role as infrastructure glue rather than pretending to be a platform.
